admission_and_stop_conditions: Freeze one exact hypothesis, manifest, deterministic fractional-exposure runner, costs, windows and all-pass gate set before opening any Ulcer-overlay outcome.

Use only completed-day closes. Primary computes a 28-day Ulcer Index and compares it with the median of the prior 252 available Ulcer values, holding 100 percent BTC at or below the lagged median and 50 percent BTC above it. Rejection-only neighbors use 21 and 35 days with the same lagged 252-observation median rule.

Require positive normal and stress returns, materially better Validation drawdown and Calmar, at least 70 percent upside capture, annual breadth, bounded turnover and no terminal-inventory uplift; otherwise permanently close the exact family.

Any ambiguity in rolling-peak reset, squared drawdown averaging, lagged-median availability, fractional rebalancing, fee/slippage accounting or next-open execution returns evidence insufficient before outcome access.
A positive historical result may create at most one REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED candidate and one independent sealed OOS gate; it authorizes no Trading action.
causal_hypothesis: The Ulcer Index accumulates both the depth and persistence of recent underwater prices. Reducing only half the exposure when that path-dependent downside burden is high relative to its own lagged annual distribution may limit persistent bear-path losses while preserving a passive BTC core during fast recoveries.
claim_boundary: This prior makes one exact daily Ulcer28 lagged-median 100/50-percent passive-core risk overlay preregistration-ready only. It establishes a drawdown-depth-duration formula, an executable free data path and a distinct economic structure, not alpha, a candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
economic_hypothesis: A daily full-or-half BTC exposure policy using lagged relative Ulcer stress may preserve at least 70 percent of buy-and-hold upside while reducing drawdown enough to improve fee- and slippage-adjusted Calmar with annual and 21/35-day neighbor breadth.

independence_assessment.not_binary_daily_ta: The overlay never goes fully to cash and does not use oscillator, moving-average, breakout or band direction. It changes exposure from 100 to 50 percent using cumulative downside path burden.
independence_assessment.not_dra_drawdown_admission: Closed DRA drawdown families gated discrete new lot entries using single-day path drawdown or 90-day recovery. This standalone overlay continuously preserves a 50-percent passive BTC core and measures 21/28/35-day drawdown depth plus duration.
independence_assessment.not_monthly_volatility_target: The closed monthly 30-day volatility target scaled exposure from symmetric close-to-close variance at a monthly clock. This family uses downside-only squared rolling drawdowns, a daily clock, a lagged self-normalized regime boundary and a fixed passive core.
independence_assessment.residual_risk: A risk metric is not automatically a return predictor. The overlay may de-risk after losses and miss recoveries, so prior confidence is low-to-moderate and only one frozen screen is allowed.

missing_proof: No primary source establishes this exact lagged-median Ulcer overlay for Bitcoin; the external evidence supports the risk measure, not forecastability or trading value.
No schema-valid hypothesis, manifest or deterministic fractional-exposure runner is frozen yet.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The original indicator creator describes the Ulcer Index as a measure of drawdown depth and duration designed for market timing and dynamic asset-allocation evaluation rather than symmetric return volatility.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Peter G. Martin and Byron McCann, Ulcer Index and Ulcer Performance Index
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Risk-measure identity does not establish a BTC timing edge, a lookback, a threshold or an exposure level.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: A peer-reviewed portfolio-performance analysis defines Ulcer as the square root of mean squared drawdowns and states that it evaluates drawdown depth and duration, with lower values indicating better portfolio performance.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Mean-Variance-VaR portfolios: MIQP formulation and performance analysis, OR Spectrum, DOI 10.1007/s00291-023-00719-x
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Evaluation utility is not predictive evidence. The exact causal exposure overlay must pass matched-capital Validation and path-risk gates.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: Existing sealed Agora results show that full-cash daily technical states repeatedly lost too much 2023-2024 upside, while static or monthly exposure changes can improve aggregate totals for non-alpha reasons. This motivates retaining a passive core and explicitly attributing drawdown, upside and terminal inventory.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Agora sealed daily-technical and allocation failure tree through CCI14
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Prior failures prohibit rescuing any exposed signal. Ulcer depth-duration is a new feature family and must be tested once without borrowing outcomes or relaxing gates.
